text:
hana: opened PR to correct API ref for POST /v1/generate and the cURL examples. Found a couple of small but breaking mismatches while validating the new Go SDK: 

- `top_p` is documented as `integer` with enum [0,1] in openapi.yaml but runtime accepts floats in (0.0, 1.0] (we use nucleus sampling).
- `n` (number of completions) was accidentally documented as a boolean in one example block (`n: false`) because of a copy-paste bug. Should be integer >=1.
- response examples in the API ref omit `model_version` and `meta` fields that the runtime now returns. Several platform teams parse `model_version` to validate rollout behavior.
- cURL examples in docs/reference/generate.md use `-H "Content-Type: application/x-ndjson"` by mistake for the non-streaming endpoint; should be `application/json`. That trips some CI scripts.

hana: pasted the current wrong snippets in the PR to make it obvious. short snippets here: 
```yaml
parameters:
  top_p:
    type: integer
    enum: [0, 1]
  n:
    example: false
```
and the response example in the doc: 
```json
{
  "id": "r-001",
  "choices": [{"text": "ok"}],
  "tokens": 9
}
```

hana: runtime actually returns: 
```json
{
  "id": "r-001",
  "choices": [{"text": "ok"}],
  "tokens": 9,
  "model_version": "generate-v2.3",
  "meta": {"served_by": "gpu-7", "path": "/v1/generate"}
}
```

ricardo: ouch. good catches. i'll update openapi.yaml: change `top_p` to number/float with minimum: 0.0 and maximum: 1.0, add `n` as integer with minimum: 1. i'll add `model_version` (string) and `meta` (object additionalProperties: true) to the 200 response schema.

sylvie: +1, and please add a small note in the API ref example describing `meta` as unstable internal telemetry and recommend clients not to rely on its keys. we don't want SDKs to treat it as stable.

hana: also note the cURL header bug — i added a failing lint test in the PR that scans docs for Content-Type mismatch. CI flagged docs/reference/generate.md line 42.

docs-bot: docs/lint found 1 incorrect Content-Type in docs/reference/generate.md: "application/x-ndjson" used for non-streaming example (line 42)

ricardo: fixed the header and updated the cURL example to use application/json. Also changed the YAML snippet to: 
```yaml
parameters:
  top_p:
    type: number
    format: float
    minimum: 0.0
    maximum: 1.0
    description: "Nucleus sampling probability mass (0.0-1.0)"
  n:
    type: integer
    minimum: 1
```

ricardo: response schema patch (added): `model_version: {type: string}`, `meta: {type: object, additionalProperties: true, description: "Unstable internal telemetry - may change"}`. i added an example showing model_version too.

ben: small nit — when you add `top_p` as float please ensure the JS SDK example shows a decimal (e.g., 0.8) so generated docs/examples don't accidentally stick to integers. i'll add a one-liner in the JS snippets.

sylvie: also add a migration note under docs/migration/v1.5.md calling out `top_p` type change and the new optional `model_version` field so integrators know to regenerate typed clients. mention the cURL header fix as well so automation scripts are aware.

hana: done — pushed changes, updated examples (JS cURL and Go snippet) and migration note. fixed the broken anchor in guides/quickstart.md that CI pointed out.

docs-bot: openapi-check reported a broken anchor in docs/guides/quickstart.md: line 10

hana: fixed anchor and force-pushed.

docs-bot: All checks passed ✅ (unit, lint, openapi-check)

ricardo: LGTM from eng. sylvie, any final docs nits?

sylvie: looked through the rendered preview. a couple of wording nits on the meta description, otherwise approve.

ben: approved from SDK team — i'll kick off a client regen job after merge.

hana: merging now. i'll follow up with two small PRs: one that updates the Go SDK examples and one that removes a stale ndjson example from the old streaming guide. thanks all :tada:
